articles.title: Barbara Barrie, Mrs. Barney Miller & an Oscar Nominee for ‘Breaking Away,’ Dies at 95
articles.summary: Veteran actress Barbara Barrie, renowned for her extensive career across Broadway, films, and television, including her memorable role as the wife of Barney Miller in the eponymous TV show, has passed away at the age of 95. Her daughter confirmed the news of her demise. Barrie left a significant mark on the entertainment industry with her distinguished presence on stage and screen.

articles.title: Behind the Paper: Vitamin C Deficiency in a Northern Saskatchewan Population, Canada
articles.summary: A recent study published in PLOS Global Public Health, led by Jeff Irvine, investigates Vitamin C deficiency within a population in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada. The research delves into the prevalence and underlying factors contributing to this public health challenge in the region. This work underscores the importance of nutritional understanding and health interventions in specific communities.

articles.title: Barbara Barrie Dies: Star Of Broadway And ‘Barney Miller’ Was 95
articles.summary: Barbara Barrie, a distinguished actress, earned a Tony nomination for her role in Broadway’s original "Company" and an Oscar nomination for her performance in "Breaking Away." She was also widely recognized for portraying Hal Linden’s character's wife in a well-known production. Her career highlights significant contributions to both theatre and film.
